svg.title: How StreamingLeRobotDataset makes one training frame, now and stacked
svg.desc: Now, each frame needs 3 files and 3 decode calls, one after another: 5.5 ms of CPU. Stacked, one file and one decode call, then a cut into 3 images: 2.9 ms. In 11 ms, separate files finish 2 frames and stacked finishes 3.8.
svg.text: How StreamingLeRobotDataset makes one training frame
Now, and what we tested. Slowed down about 800x. Times are measured CPU time per frame.
Tested: the 3 views stacked in one MP4

g.text: Same 11 ms: separate files finish 2 frames, stacked finishes 3.8.

svg.text: Network is not drawn: in streaming, one 5 MB download holds about 1,700 frames. The 5.5 ms is split into 3 equal parts for the picture.
